description: Use this when someone asks how many gallons a common pool size holds, e.g. a 24 ft round above-ground pool with a 52 in wall or a 16 x 32 inground pool, or wants a table of standard sizes. Returns inground rectangles (12x24 to 25x50 ft at 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 ft average depth) and above-ground round and oval pools (12-33 ft round, 12x24 to 21x41 ft oval at 48, 52 and 54 in walls) with the factors used. For any other size or shape use pool_volume.
name: pool_facts

link.description: Page of calculatepool.com for the same calculation.

title: Standard pool sizes in gallons
